queries_run: Coinbase business model shift subscription platform "everything exchange" 2026
Coinbase distribution channel disintermediation Robinhood ETF banks crypto trading 2026

findings.claim: Coinbase 10-K FY2025：Coinbase One 訂閱制 2025 新增 Basic 檔，共三個會員層級，並推出 Coinbase One 信用卡；訂閱產生經常性收入並深化用戶參與。
findings.excerpt: In 2025, we launched an additional subscription tier, Coinbase One Basic, offering consumers essential benefits for a lower subscription fee. There are now three membership tiers under Coinbase One: Basic, Preferred, and Premium.

findings.claim: 搜尋摘要：Coinbase 2026 策略為「Everything Exchange」，Q1 2026 訂閱與服務占淨收入 44%，納入預測市場、零售衍生品、代幣化股票與商品永續合約（二手彙整，未核一手）。
findings.source: WebSearch 彙整（Coinbase Q4 25 Earnings Call 等）

findings.claim: Coinbase 2026 roadmap：成為 everything exchange（股票、預測市場、商品）、擴大 USDC 支付、建 Base 超級應用
